cowboysDuel.title: Cowboys: Duel Tutorial
cowboysDuel.description: Walk through a fixed duel sequence featuring Pinkerton, duel-card timing, and Deputy resolution.

steps.setup: Preparing the Cowboys duel tutorial scenario…
steps.duelIntro: This tutorial focuses only on the Cowboys duel mechanic. You will see the challenge, Pinkerton counter timing, duel-card windows, and Deputy boost before the duel resolves.
steps.playGunfighter: Play Gunfighter first, then target the enemy Microbot in the Saloon to start the duel.
steps.pecosBillWindow: When the duel starts, the Cowboys titan Pecos Bill asks whether you want to discard a card and join this duel. Skip it here so the tutorial can stay focused on the core duel flow.
steps.pinkertonCounter: Pinkerton triggers before duel cards resolve. Place 1 +1 power counter on your dueling minion.
steps.duelCard: Now your duel-card window opens. Skip it in this tutorial so we can focus on the core Cowboys duel flow.
steps.opponentDuelCard: The opponent has no extra response here, so the tutorial will automatically pass their duel-card window.
steps.deputyBoost: Discard Deputy now to give Gunfighter +2 power until end of turn and secure the duel win.
steps.finish: The duel has resolved: the enemy minion is gone, Deputy is in your discard pile, and there is no active duel left. You have completed the core Cowboys duel flow.

steps.aiPlayMinion:
Look! Our "Star-Spawn of Cthulhu" has appeared on the base.

This power-5 minion has a Talent ability — you'll get to activate it shortly.
steps.welcome:
Welcome to Smash Up!

In this game, you pick two factions and shuffle their decks together, then compete to score bases and earn Victory Points.

First to 15 VP wins!
steps.scoreboard:
This is the scoreboard, showing each player's Victory Points (VP) and chosen factions.

Your goal is to reach 15 VP first!
steps.handIntro:
This is your hand area. Your deck is a mix of cards from your two factions.

Cards come in two types:
• Minions — placed on bases to contribute power
• Actions — trigger special effects
steps.turnTracker:
This shows the current turn number and game phase.

Each turn follows: Play Cards → Score Bases → Draw.
steps.endTurnBtn: This is the End Phase button. After you're done with each phase, click it to move on.
steps.playCardsExplain:
It's the Play Cards phase!

Each turn you may play 1 minion and 1 action (one of each).

Minions go on bases to add power; actions trigger special effects.
steps.playMinion:
Try playing a minion!

Click the "Librarian" in your hand to select it, then choose a base to place it on.

This power-4 minion has a Talent ability — once it's on the base, you can activate it!
steps.playAction:
Nice! Now play an action card.

The "Howl" action gives all your minions +1 power. Click the action card in your hand to select it, then click it again to use it.
steps.useTalent:
Notice the glowing golden "Librarian" on the base!

Some minions have Talent abilities that can be activated once per turn.

Click the glowing "Librarian" to use its Talent — discard a Madness card and draw a card!
steps.endPlayCards: Done playing cards! Click the End Phase button to proceed.
steps.baseScoring:
Base Scoring: when the total power of all minions on a base reaches or exceeds its breakpoint, that base scores.

After scoring, minions on the base are discarded and a new base is revealed.
steps.vpAwards:
When a base scores, the top 3 players by power receive the VP rewards shown on the base card.

The player with the most power gets the biggest reward!
steps.drawExplain: Draw phase: at the end of each turn you draw 2 cards to refill your hand.
steps.handLimit:
Note the hand limit is 10 cards.

If you exceed the limit after drawing, you must discard down to 10.
steps.endDraw: Draw phase complete! When your hand is at or under 10 cards, the phase advances automatically.
steps.opponentTurn: It's your opponent's turn now. Watch what they do...
steps.talentIntro:
Some minions have Talent abilities that can be used once per turn.

Look for the Talent marker on minion cards! Talents reset at the start of your turn.
steps.turnCycle:
Turns alternate between players, each following Play Cards → Score → Draw.

Use your plays wisely to build power advantages on key bases!
steps.summary:
Tutorial complete! Key takeaways:

• Pick 2 factions and shuffle them together
• Each turn: play 1 minion + 1 action
• Bases score when total power hits the breakpoint
• First to 15 VP wins
steps.finish: You've learned the basics of Smash Up. Ready to smash?
